messages:
Priya (Marketing): Heads-up — I'm assembling a sales-ready security digest for enterprise prospects. Goal: single A4 'security digest' (one sheet), 3 benchmark slides, and a short webinar script. Want this live next week. Owners + ETA by EOD Fri?

Marco (Sales): Love this. Can we include a quick persona mapping (Platform eng, SecOps, Legal) and an explicit 'what we guarantee' SLA snippet? I can draft sales examples.

Alex (Product): I'll take SLA copy + bullets for deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). I'll use legal-approved phrasing where possible. ETA: Thu noon.

Rachel (Demand Gen): I'll own webinar script and CTAs. Need benchmark highlights and 2-3 reproducible slides from eng. Planning for a 30min webinar + 10 Q.

Chad (Eng): Putting numbers into the perf sheet now: https://drive.google.com/perf-spreadsheet-draft
Key highlights: p95 latency Hosted ~120ms, Dedicated ~85ms, Private (on-prem) ~110ms. Throughput notes in sheet.

Priya (Marketing): Nice — can someone export 2 graphs (latency p95 and token cost per 1k) as PNG 1200x800 for slides? Prefer white bg.

Elena (Field SE): I'll write a short 'security evaluation' checklist for reviewers: network config, key mgmt, audit logs, data residency, integration notes.

Priya (Marketing): Draft checklist (placeholder) — feel free to edit:

```
Security checklist for reviewers:\n- Network: VPC peering or private link, allowed IP ranges
- Keys: KMS/HSM integration, rotation guidance
- Logs: Audit log retention, access controls
- Data flow: what leaves vs stays on-prem, encryption in transit/rest
- SLA: uptime, latency SLOs, support hours
- Compliance: SOC2/GDPR notes & where to find artifacts
```

Marco (Sales): :thumbsup: This checklist will help field calls. Can we add expected lead routing rules? E.g., 'If customer requires private + SLA commit => route to AE team B'.

Priya (Marketing): Good call. For routing: default lead -> SDR, Private deployment + security reqs -> Enterprise AE + Solutions Eng. I'll add a small flowchart.

Chris (Brand): I'll take layout + final art for the one-sheet and slides. Confirming brand: use dark header, security stripe color, Notre font. Need final copy by Thu 4pm to hit Fri launch.

Alex (Product): Thu noon confirmed for copy handoff.

Rachel (Demand Gen): I'll have webinar outline by Wed EOD. Holding CTA as 'start a 2-week dedicated pilot' + 'security review pack'.

Priya (Marketing): Draft task list + links:
- SLA & deploy bullets — Alex — https://docs.company/sla-draft (Thu noon)
- Benchmarks slide export — Chad/Eng — https://drive.google.com/perf-spreadsheet-draft (Wed EOD)
- Webinar script + slides outline — Rachel — (Wed EOD)
- Security checklist — Elena — (Thu noon)
- Design/layout (A4 + slides) — Chris — (Thu 4pm)
- Legal review (SLA language) — @legal-bot — (Thu EOD)

Priya (Marketing): If no major objections I'll finalize and queue for Friday publish/send to field. Any blockers?

chris (Brand): One question — do we want a standalone benchmark narrative PDF or embed stats in the one-sheet? I vote embed top metrics + 'deep-dive' link.

Marco (Sales): Embed top metrics. Deep-dive link = good for technical buyers.

Priya (Marketing): Agreed. Deep-dive PDF linked from the one-sheet.

legal-bot: Notified legal reviewers. Please allow 24h for SLA language review.

Priya (Marketing): Great — thanks everyone. I'll create a shared folder and drop final assets once we have copy + slides. Folder: https://drive.google.com/marketing-security-digest (internal)

Priya (Marketing): Quick follow-up: I'm adding a 2-line launch post for field comms. If anyone has specific phrases to avoid (legal/sensitive), flag now.

Alex (Product): Avoid specifics about customer data movement for named customers. Keep language high-level.

Priya (Marketing): Noted. Closing with ETA: aiming to ship to field on Fri by EOD. If any changes, ping here. Thanks! :rocket:
